propositions: CLI facade reconstructs command identity through 19 overlapping frozensets and lacks canonical help for 21 intercept-only commands
Parser/help drift passes undetected due to hand-maintained help resources and curated intercept table decoupled from parser definitions
Existing `rebar help <command>` reports intercept commands as unknown while handler-owned `--help` is inconsistent and may execute work
Canonical command grammar must derive from a single side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory used by both runtime execution and build-time generation
Generated package-help and overview bytes must be committed and runtime-authoritative so help paths execute before operation, config materialization, or handler resolution

Duplicate command identity/policy authorities must be consolidated into one immutable lazy route registry mapping canonical identity, spellings, handlers, parsers, capabilities, and compatibility rules
